about.title: About
about.subtitle: Open-source platform for sport mafia online.

goal.title: Goal
goal.body: Promote mafia as a game — its pace, psychology, team thinking. Not as a subculture or a "closed club", but as an accessible hobby that any ten people with a browser and a free evening can play.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body1_suffix: , outside the internal disputes of the mafia community. We don't issue ratings for titles, don't join any association, and don't dictate the single "correct" rulebook.
mission.body2: The platform is infrastructure, not a faction. Hosts run games the way they like; clubs and tournaments are the next step, but even there we don't become the arbiter of "how to play properly".

practice.title: What this means in practice
items: No mandatory accounts with federation verification.
Base rules — classic 10-seat mafia, but rulesets are pluggable.
Open-source, MIT-licensed. Anyone can run their own copy.
Mainstream stack: Node.js + React + WebRTC. So there's someone to maintain it.

status.title: Status
status.body: Currently in beta. Bugs, changes and temporary fixes are expected. This isn't yet the final product — but the core game loop already works.
